title: DOME Observatory AI/ML landscape record
description: One document per screened publication. Source of truth for this shape is dome-triage/mongo_landscape_export/scripts/schema.py (build_document()) -- this file documents that shape for consumers outside dome-triage (this repo's frontend and, from Phase 5, its backend). See schema/README.md for how this file is versioned and kept in sync.

_id.description: Deterministic PID (UUID5, fixed namespace, pmcid>doi>pmid priority) minted per record -- the same paper always mints the same PID, so this is stable across re-runs and safe to use in URLs (/record/:pid).

schema_version.description: The shape of this document, e.g. "1.1.0" -- describes the document's structure, not the paper's content or any processing run. Bump only when this module's document shape changes; see schema/CHANGELOG.md.

identifiers.description: Every external identifier and cross-reference for this paper. pmid/pmcid/doi come from the source corpus; the rest are reserved for a future linking pass and are always null today.

pmid.description: PubMed ID, bare digits. Blank in ~8.2% of the source corpus.

pmcid.description: PubMed Central ID, e.g. "PMC12283288". Null when the paper has no PMC full text. Blank in ~24.5% of the source corpus.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier, e.g. "10.3389/fimmu.2025.1608262". Blank in <1% of the source corpus.

dome_registry.description: Reserved: cross-reference to a matching DOME Registry entry, if one exists. Always null until the linking pass runs.

bioai_repo.description: Reserved: cross-reference to a code/method repository. Always null until the linking pass runs.

huggingface.description: Reserved: cross-reference to a HuggingFace model/dataset. Always null until the linking pass runs.

kaggle.description: Reserved: cross-reference to a Kaggle dataset/notebook. Always null until the linking pass runs.

zenodo.description: Reserved: cross-reference to a Zenodo deposition. Always null until the linking pass runs.

title.description: Paper title, plain text. Blank in <0.1% of the source corpus.

abstract.description:
Paper abstract. Can contain embedded HTML-ish tags (e.g. "

Background

") -- render accordingly, don't assume plain text. Blank in ~5.4% of the source corpus.

authors.description: Comma-separated author list as one plain-text string, e.g. "Liang L, Liang H, He M". Blank in ~1.0% of the source corpus.

journal.description: Journal name, plain text. Blank in ~6.8% of the source corpus.

citation_count.description: Forward-compatible placeholder -- always null in the current corpus (never populated upstream), kept in the shape deliberately rather than dropped.

abstract_source.description: Which upstream source the abstract text came from -- observed values: europepmc (~93.5%), crossref, pubmed. Blank in ~5.4% of the source corpus.

metadata_repair_sources.description: Which repair pass(es) touched this row's metadata, e.g. "ncbi_idconv". Blank in ~91% of the source corpus (most rows needed no repair).

open_access.description: Whether the paper is open access. ~66% true across the source corpus.

license.description: License string joined from the Europe PMC licensing lookup, e.g. "cc by". Null where no license lookup matched.

fulltext_available.description: Whether full text (not just abstract) is available. ~74% true across the source corpus.

content_filters.description: Content descriptors: the first three sub-fields (mesh_headings/pub_types/keywords_author) come from the source corpus and are populated for every record. The remaining six are the AI/ML enrichment pass's output -- present in every document but null/empty until that pass actually runs on a given record. See vocab/domain.json and vocab/modelling-branch.json for the controlled vocabularies and their cardinality caps (max_tags).

mesh_headings.description: MeSH headings assigned to the paper, e.g. ["Humans", "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"]. Populated for every record.

pub_types.description: Publication types, e.g. ["research-article", "Journal Article"]. Populated for every record.

keywords_author.description: Author-supplied keywords. Populated for every record (may be an empty array if the paper listed none).

domain_tier1.description: EDAM topic branch, tier 1 (broadest). Single-select -- max_tags: 1. See vocab/domain.json for the 13 controlled terms. Null until the enrichment pass runs on this record.

domain_tier2.description: EDAM topic branch, tier 2. Multi-select -- max_tags: 2. See vocab/domain.json for the 121 controlled terms. Empty until the enrichment pass runs on this record.

domain_tier3.description: EDAM topic branch, tier 3 (most specific). Multi-select -- max_tags: 3. See vocab/domain.json for the 125 controlled terms. Empty until the enrichment pass runs on this record.

learning_paradigm.description: How the model learns -- textbook-consensus axis (supervised / unsupervised / semi-supervised / reinforcement). Multi-select -- max_tags: 2. See vocab/modelling-branch.json. Empty until the enrichment pass runs on this record.

model_family.description: What kind of system/method family -- a cross-cutting, multi-label axis distinct from learning_paradigm (e.g. deep learning, large language model, ensemble learning). Multi-select -- max_tags: 3. See vocab/modelling-branch.json. Empty until the enrichment pass runs on this record.

model_type.description: The specific method(s) used, e.g. "random forest", "XGBoost". Deliberately OPEN free text, not a closed enum: vocab/model-type-seed.json's 76 canonical terms + aliases are coverage assurance and normalization only -- the canonical spelling is emitted on a match, otherwise the paper's own term is tagged verbatim. Empty until the enrichment pass runs on this record.

llm_classification.description: The positive/negative/undeterminable screening decision and its provenance. Populated for every record -- this is the pass that already ran on the full corpus.

classification.description: The screening verdict: positive = genuine AI/ML methods paper. Corpus-wide: 355,569 positive, 464,603 negative, 6,923 undeterminable.

rationale.description: Free-text model rationale for the classification decision. Always LLM-generated -- surface this fact to users, don't present it as a human judgement.

prompt_version.description: Version tag of the prompt template used, e.g. "v1".

ruleset_sha256.description: sha256 of the criteria the classification was run against -- lets a later run detect if the criteria changed.

batch_id.description: Identifier of the classification batch/run this record's event came from.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the classification event.

llm_enrichment.description: Deliberately PARALLEL in shape to llm_classification (same provenance fields) -- this is the enrichment pass that populates content_filters.domain_tier1-3/learning_paradigm/model_family/model_type. Every field is present now (all null) rather than a single null placeholder, precisely so no schema migration is needed once this pass actually runs on a record.

model_id.description: Exact model id used for enrichment.

rationale.description: Free-text model rationale for the enrichment tags assigned.

prompt_version.description: Version tag of the enrichment prompt template used.

ruleset_sha256.description: sha256 of the vocabulary/criteria the enrichment was run against.

batch_id.description: Identifier of the enrichment batch/run this record's event came from.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the enrichment event.

vocab_violations.description: Any tag the model emitted that didn't match a controlled vocabulary term -- logged, not silently dropped.

parse_status.description: Whether the model's structured output parsed cleanly.

input_tokens.description: Input token count for the enrichment call.

output_tokens.description: Output token count for the enrichment call.

cache_hit_tokens.description: Cached input token count for the enrichment call.

parse_fallback_used.description: Whether a fallback parser had to be used to recover the model's output.
